effect_summary: Whether stand ET falls or rises after thinning, and how fast LAI and ET recover, depended strongly on plant-accessible storage; deep storage gave faster ET recovery.

location_name: Southern Sierra Nevada (Grant Grove forcing; SCZO calibration)
effect_summary: When remaining trees could use water freed by removed trees, LAI and biomass recovered faster and ET stayed higher; with shallow storage, stand ET exceeded pre-thinning in some years.

location_name: Southern Sierra Nevada (Grant Grove forcing; SCZO calibration)
effect_summary: Across 13 post-treatment climate trajectories, the year-2 ET change after 40% thinning (mid storage, shared roots) ranged from about -100 to +30 mm/yr; drought years following a growth release lowered NPP of remaining trees.
context_note: Treatment start year varied 1955-2015 in 5-yr steps with 15-yr recovery; trajectories overlap so are not independent.
